fact: At the May 2023 KIX peer review, Lesotho's education data was collected by institution on paper-based annual survey forms; OpenEMIS, piloted in 2017-2018 as a learner unit record system, was being used only to capture the Annual School Census after the Ministry reverted to school-level aggregated data, the EMIS policy was not finalised, and the Ministry was about to shift to DHIS2 for Education.
title: Policy Brief: KIX EMIS Peer Review, Ministry of Education, Lesotho
